description: CONTRACT_SPEC.md §7.1-§7.3: a first POST /v1/ingest with a fresh (session_id, batch_sequence) persists the raw envelope byte-faithfully and returns 200 status 'persisted'. The body is the raw octet-stream (no JSON wrapper, no base64); body_hex is the lowercase-hex encoding of the 33-byte minimum envelope. SHAPE vector — full-pipeline dedupe behaviour is independently verified at Groups 12/13 per §17.4.
notes: received_at is sourced from ingested_batch_keys.first_seen_at per R-G7-DEDUP-TABLE.

description: CONTRACT_SPEC.md §7.2-§7.3: a second POST with the same (session_id, batch_sequence) as ingestion_persisted_001 returns 200 status 'deduplicated' (not an error, and no second payload INSERT). The idempotency key is structural (the ingested_batch_keys primary key). SHAPE vector.

preconditions: ingestion_persisted_001 was already accepted for this (session_id, batch_sequence)

notes: originally_persisted_at echoes the first call's first_seen_at; no second sample_batches INSERT occurs.
